verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes an XML API (production and sandbox endpoints), and its official Go SDK documents a charge-bearing domain-registration call (CreateWithContext), plus availability check, renew, registrar lock and per-TLD capability listing. That covers the scriptable purchase core of the story, and the sandbox allows safe testing in a deploy pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of contact-setting parameters/calls, explicit nameserver-assignment calls (the Terraform provider covers DNS records, not registration nameservers), and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end scripted registration.
